description:
i2pd (I2P Daemon) is a full-featured C++ implementation of I2P client.

i2pd (I2P Daemon) is a full-featured C++ implementation of I2P client.
I2P (Invisible Internet Protocol) is a universal anonymous network layer.
All communications over I2P are anonymous and end-to-end encrypted, participants don"t reveal their real IP addresses.
1.  Torrents tunnels with RPC, magnets, PEX, DHT, datagram trackers support
2.  Full SAM 3.3 implementation
3.  Multi-destination client tunnels
4.  Offline keys for an encrypted LeaseSet
5.  Fixed Datagram2 signatures
6.  Faster LeaseSet lookups
7.  Less datagram loss ratio
8.  New UDP tunnels window and ack policy. Fixed stalled UDP tunnels
9.  Added "LocalDestinationInfo" method to I2PControl
10. Fixed SAM session disconnect after reconnect
11. Create keys files readable by owner only
12. Reject LeaseSet type 1 if coming from ECIESx25519 session
13. Close HTTP server connection if invalid or too long headers
14. Allow ipv6 binding for Haiku
15. Reject ipv4-mapped ipv6 addresses in RouterInfo
16. Updated reseeds list
